scope: Screen Coin3D Dime as an additional independent open-source C++ DXF parser/model and explicit-geometry projection route; establish version, binary-format, writer, graph, and ACIS evidence limits.

method.kind: Primary project documentation and public API source review
method.evidenceBoundary: Coin3D Dime documentation and public API statements were inspected only. No claim is made about current runtime behavior, exact source pin, arbitrary DXF preservation, or unlisted entity semantics.

evidence.observed: Dime is a BSD-3-Clause C++ library for reading, constructing, manipulating, and writing DXF data models. Official docs identify the documented library as 0.9.1 and say internal tests covered DXF versions 10-14, with customer-reported AutoCAD 2000 use.
doesNotEstablish: a verified modern DXF version matrix
any DWG read or write route
runtime correctness of a specific build or release artifact
complete document graph or semantic fidelity
evidence.planUse: Optional legacy ASCII-DXF parser/model comparison only, with exact source revision and locally authored controls.

evidence.observed: Dime's input API labels its binary mode DXB, reports DXB-specific group-code handling, and returns version values 10, 12, 13, or 14. DXB is a separate format from AutoCAD Binary DXF.
evidence.planUse: Exclude Dime from binary-DXF peer evidence.

evidence.observed: Dime's class inventory includes classic entities including 3DFACE, SOLID, TRACE, POLYLINE, and INSERT. Its extractGeometry API describes viewer-oriented indexed vertex extraction and says caller traversal must apply current transformation and UCS matrices.
doesNotEstablish: all entity classes have geometry extraction
native CAD graph or owner-reference preservation
independent geometric correctness without a separate expected manifest
evidence.planUse: At a composed checkpoint, optionally compare only exact overlapping explicit-geometry projection with hand-computed transform expectations.

evidence.observed: The API lists generic unknown entity/object/section/table classes. The dimeOutput summary mentions DXF and DXB, while the same documentation says its binary setBinary mode currently supports only ASCII and the binary header writer is a no-op pending support.
doesNotEstablish: safe handle remapping or lossless graph replay of unknown data
evidence.planUse: Do not use generic unknown classes or API-summary wording as opaque-graph or writer qualification.

nextActions: Keep Dime as LEGACY_DXF_PROJECTION_ONLY and optional composed-check evidence.
Do not add a build dependency, CTest, or per-slice peer run.
If a future pinned Dime build is already available, use source-authored legacy ASCII DXF controls and compare exact tags, parsed values, and projected coordinates separately.
Keep modern DXF, Binary DXF, DWG, opaque graph, and ACIS/B-rep claims outside this route.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
